name: Enamine_search_catalog
description: DEPRECATED / non-functional (verified 2026-11-01): the Enamine Store API this tool calls has been withdrawn. https://new.enaminestore.com/api/... now 302-redirects to https://enaminestore.com/api/..., which answers 404 for every path (catalog/search, catalog/compound/{id}, catalog/structure-search, libraries); the store front-end is a Next.js app that exposes no documented public API, and https://enamine.net/api/ is an unrelated Joomla endpoint. Every call therefore returns an error. For Enamine's catalogue use PubChem, which holds 5,199,802 Enamine substances as a depositor source: PubChem_get_CID_by_compound_name with the catalog number as 'name' (EN300-00002 resolves to CID 220107) and PubChem_get_substances_by_source with source='Enamine'. Search Enamine compound catalog by keyword or name when the Enamine Store API is available. The tool returns an explicit error rather than a successful empty result when the upstream endpoint is unavailable. JSON payloads support local limit/offset pagination, with metadata warning that upstream global completeness is undocumented.

query.description: Search query - compound name or keyword

catalog.description: Catalog: REAL (make-on-demand), BB (building blocks), SCR (screening), all (default: all)

limit.description: Maximum records from the returned API payload.

offset.description: Zero-based offset within the returned API payload.
